quotes.text: “ Behold, verily, thus saith the Lord unto you, in consequence of evils and designs which do and will exist in the hearts of conspiring men in the last days, I have warned you and forewarn you, by giving unto you this word of wisdom by revelation, that inasmuch as any man drinketli wine or strong drink among you, behold it is not good, neither mete in the sight of your Father, only in assembling…

3. Wherefore, a commandment I give unto you, that you shall not
    purchase wine, neither strong drink of your enemies:
it will be said to you; ‘Arise, shine, for thy light has come, and the glory of the Lord has risen upon thee,”
